task.title: Claim exact recurrence occurrences through the CLI
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/935 to expose exact recurrence claim semantics as a deterministic writable CLI adapter.
acceptance_criteria: Validate recurrence identity before storage access and delegate revision, cutoff, and lifecycle semantics.
Emit complete escaped claim JSON and preserve durable reopen evidence.
Map rejected states to one stable stderr diagnostic with no stdout or append.

attempts.summary: Implemented and refactored the bounded slice.
attempts.diagnostic: Implemented recurrence claim parsing, pre-storage validation, exact store delegation, deterministic JSON, diagnostics, tests, and ADR-0070.
attempts.patch: Implemented the issue 935 contract in crates/vela-dev/src/lib.rs with focused tests and synchronized architecture and behavior documentation.

attempts.diagnostic: Independent review requested exact-revision reclaim coverage for released state, which was added before commit; substantive CodeRabbit review generated no actionable comments.
attempts.patch: Applied blocking findings where present, reran verification, required substantive review, and preserved zero unresolved review threads before merge.

outcome.summary: Issue 935 delivered the documented recurrence boundary with strict evidence, bounded authority, and verified merge provenance.

verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate for pull request 936 exact head

lessons: CLI adapters should not reimplement lifecycle state machines.
Independent review identified missing exact-revision reclaim coverage for released state; the focused regression was added before commit.
The caller supplies coordinate, observed revision, and inclusive cutoff.
The command adds no ambient clock, identity generation, materialization, or execution authority.
